findings.title: RC-2 preregistration is backdatable because its only home is the run being preregistered

the only explicit ordering predicate is preregistered_at earlier than collection_started_at
the evidence manifest contract anchors files after the run but provides no independently immutable precollection event
a simulated operator can inspect discarded trials, choose a PASS trial, then create a conforming manifest with a backdated timestamp and attempt_index 1
findings.impact: selection of the canonical run can depend on observed outcome while appearing preregistered, changing coverage, stress bounds, and conclusions
findings.closure_required: anchor a separate preregistration artifact or digest before collection in a pushed commit, append-only precollection ledger, or externally ordered seal; the run manifest must reference that anchor and all attempted/discarded runs must be enumerable
